{{Quote|First Nerrik. Then Jak, then Haze. Now Ford. I don't think I can take it anymore.|One of Sylas Wilkes's men|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ford''' was a criminal in the employ of [[Sylas Wilkes]] who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a [[Tulak Hord's artifact (Tatooine)|Sith artifact]] for their boss on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] with the blasters and the artifacts. Ford was killed several days afterwards during a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] attack.
